messages:
Anya: FYI — Aegis Health just signed an enterprise commit. Need a POC capacity plan + preheat/runway. POC starts next Mon. They expect bursty peaks: ~350 rps for 20-40s, steady 35-45 rps otherwise. Asking for reserved vs burst sizing and autoscale fallbacks.
Devon: Can you paste their traffic profile (payload sizes + token distributions) and SLA targets?
Anya: Quick profile: avg prompt ~45 tokens, avg generation ~120 tokens, occasional long job ~800 tokens. 95th latency target < 400ms. CSV in deal folder.
Martin: Gut calc: steady 40 rps -> ~2 GPUs (70B quant) w/ KV warm hits. Spikes to 350 rps need prewarmed burst pool (~6 GPUs) or autoscale with warmup + queuing. Recommend reserved 6 -> autoscale down to 2, or reserved 3 + burst credits if they prefer cost savings.
Lina: For open-70B-quant on A100-ish: ~50-70 rps/GPU at ~1k tokens baseline. KV cache warm increases throughput ~1.5x. Recommend fallback to open-13B-quant for graceful degradation.
Anya: They require Private (VPC). Does Private support reserved + burst like Dedicated?
Martin: Yes. Private supports reserved pools + controlled burst credits. Ops note: preheat & KV warmup run inside customer VPC; KMS access required for model artifacts — KMS onboarding adds ~48h.
Devon: Draft autoscale policy:
```yaml
policy:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 8
  metric: qps
  target_qps_per_replica: 60
  cool_down_seconds: 60
  prewarm: true
  prewarm_schedule: "cron(0 15 * * ? *)" # 15m before business window
```
Lina: Add KV warmup: run ~1k representative requests during preheat (use their sample prompts) — reduces cold-step latency and raises effective throughput. Also add routing policy to fallback 70B->13B.
Martin: Cost tradeoffs: reserved 6 GPUs committed monthly covers spikes up to ~280 rps without queueing. For 350 rps spikes rely on burst credits or temporary overprovision. I'll produce a cost vs SLA matrix.
Anya: Action items: Martin -> cost/runway + evict/fallback policy + TL;DR one-pager for customer by EOD. Devon -> preheat job script + staging test by EOD. Lina -> KV warmup recipe + routing config. I'll coordinate customer preheat windows. :thumbsup:
SRE-Bot: preheat-job created in staging by Devon at 2026-03-18T08:50Z — test run scheduled for 2026-03-18T09:10Z.
Customersuccess: I'll draft a cutover runbook and notify onboarding.
Devon: Adding A/B fallback plan: normal -> reserved 70B -> fallback to 13B with lower cost per token (same API surface).
Lina: I'll include perf numbers, sample prompts and expected tail latencies for the one-pager.
Anya: Sync tomorrow 10:30am PT. Thanks team — will share deliverables in deal channel after EOD.
